title: Spicy Heat
summary: Heat needs fat to spread and acid to refresh — capsaicin is oil-soluble, not water-soluble.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — spicy heat is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: capsaicin, fat, acid. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Serve with cooling yogurt or lime
Sugar and acid tame burn; dairy fat soothes without killing flavor.
